definitions.explanation: Thick, white paper used for drawing and painting. Commonly used in schools for art class.

examples.english: I drew a picture on drawing paper.

notes:
{画用紙|がようし} is thick white paper specifically designed for drawing and painting. It is a standard school supply in Japan, used in ⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧ (arts and crafts) classes.

FORMS:
{画|が} (drawing/picture) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (for use) + {紙|し} (paper)

CHARACTERISTICS:
Thicker and sturdier than ordinary ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧, making it suitable for various media including crayons, watercolors, colored pencils, and markers.

- {模造紙|もぞうし}: large chart paper
